author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Heroes of Might and Magic 3 Remake in this trailer for the upcoming remake of the turn-based strategy classic and its two expansions, rebuilt in full 3D and 4K. In Heroes of Might and Magic 3 Remake, join Queen Catherine on her crusade to restore order to the kingdom of Erathia, torn apart by her father's assassination and the onslaught of invading factions. Explore a vibrant fantasy world, build spectacular towns, and lead mighty heroes in epic, tactical battles. 

A Closed Playtest for Heroes of Might and Magic 3 Remake begins November 18, 2026, and sign-ups are open now.

#IGN #gaming
title: Heroes of Might and Magic 3 Remake - Official Closed Playtest Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Official Trailer for Arcade Dreams, an upcoming video game history documentary distributed by Uncork’d Entertainment. Explore over a century of arcade history and the games, innovators, and passionate communities that shaped gaming culture in Arcade Dreams, which releases digitally and On Demand on November 27.

Arcade Dreams centers on the clatter of pinball machines and the glow of classic arcade cabinets and the immersive experiences of modern virtual reality. The documentary celebrates the innovation, creativity, and community that have kept arcade culture alive for more than a century.

Arcade Dreams is directed by Zach Weddington and takes the audience on a whirlwind tour through arcade gaming, from the penny arcades of the early 1900s and the golden age of pinball to the explosion of video games in the 1970s and 1980s and today's arcade renaissance.

The documentary is produced by Rock Steady Media, the team behind cult classic Viva Amiga; the documentary fea
title: Arcade Dreams - Official Trailer (2026) Documentary

author: IGN
description:
Check out the new trailer for Artificial, an upcoming film starring Andrew Garfield, Yura Borisov, Monica Barbaro, Cooper Hoffman, Jason Schwartzman, Ike Barinholtz, and Mark Rylance.

From Luca Guadagnino comes the story of OpenAI and a two decade artificial intelligence arms race. When a computer scientist and AI pioneer Professor Geoffrey Hinton makes a breakthrough they are certain will alter humanity forever, Sam Altman, Elon Musk and the most prominent figures in Silicon Valley race to become part of their vision. As the technology becomes more powerful and more valuable than anyone ever imagined, a battle wages over who should control the tech that could change the fate of humanity.

Artificial, directed by Luca Guadagnino, opens in select theaters on December 25, 2026, and in theaters everywhere on January 8, 2027.
title: Artificial - Official Trailer (2027) Andrew Garfield, Monica Barbaro, Jason Schwartzman

description:
Take a look at gameplay from Adapt in this trailer for the upcoming survival sandbox game. To survive, you must guide your species through a constantly changing world in Adapt. Compete with strange creatures for food and territory, and find your niche through careful evolutionary choices. The real question is not if you can survive, but for how long. Adapt will be available on Steam. If you're interested, you can play the latest additions to Adapt in the current Steam playtest.

#Adapt #Gaming #IGN

description:
Get a recap of the stories of Metal Slug 1 and Metal Slug 2 in this latest trailer for the Metal Slug Ultimate Collection, the upcoming collection for the 2D run-and-gun series. 

The Metal Slug Ultimate Collection includes Metal Slug (1996), Metal Slug 2 (1998), Metal Slug X (1999), Metal Slug 3 (2000), Metal Slug 4 (2002), Metal Slug 5 (2003), Metal Slug Advance (2004), Metal Slug 6 (2006), Metal Slug 7 (2008), and the Metal Slug Location Test Build. 

Metal Slug Ultimate Collection will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam in 2027.

#MetalSlugUltimateCollection #Gameplay #IGN
title: Metal Slug Ultimate Collection - Official Metal Slug 1 & 2 Story Recap Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Like many open world games there are a few arcade mini games that can be found within GTA 6. Unlike other games in the series, these mini games are everything but small. Check out gameplay from all four arcade and console games from Grand Theft Auto 6, Bank For Your Buck, Street Trash 3: Dezombifier, Tenebrae Lux, and Time Jackers: Rewind. All four of these games are fully fleshed out experiences that cover multiple genres such as a rogue like twin stick shooter, an arcade hunting sim, a sci-fi action adventure, and a very artsy walking simulator, complete with cornball writing and frustrating puzzles. 
 
00:00 - Street Trash 3: Dezombifier
15:45 - Time Jackers: Rewind
30:00 - Tenebrae Lux
41:27 - Bank For Your Buck
 
All gameplay captured on an Xbox Series X
title: GTA 6 : Playing Every Arcade and Console Game

author: IGN
description:
From gameplay quirks to secrets and Easter eggs, here are 99 incredible little details in Grand Theft Auto 6. Don’t worry, you’ll find no story spoilers here. 

We're finally getting to see what Rockstar has been cooking up for the last decade-and-change. It may be a studio already famous for its unbridled attention to detail, but just how many more tiny flourishes, references, and opportunities for emergent hilarity has Rockstar stuffed into GTA 6? The answer is a lot, so let’s get straight to it: this is 99 incredible little details in GTA 6.

#IGN #GTA6 #Gaming
title: GTA 6: 99 Incredible Little Details

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at gameplay from Darkest Dungeon 2: The Butcher's Asylum in this trailer for the upcoming DLC. The Butcher's Asylum DLC is a standalone game mode for the gothic roguelike game, which brings endless waves of battle, a new playable hero, and new game features. 

Survive the bloodthirsty whims of a mad crowd! The Butcher’s Asylum invites one and all to step into the spotlight against endless hordes of enemies in a self-contained gladiatorial arena designed to test the player’s mental and physical fortitude.

Darkest Dungeon 2 is out now on PC/Mac/Linux (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2. The Butcher's Asylum DLC for Darkest Dungeon 2 will be available on PC and consoles in early 2027.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Darkest Dungeon 2: The Butcher's Asylum - Official Gameplay Trailer
